notablePrerequisites: You have at least three land cards in hand.
description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Slogurk's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Slogurk's first ability triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Slogurk's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Slogurk's third ability triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
